Hi, I'm Vaibhav Korrapati. I worked on AI infrastructure at Amazon, most recently
on AWS SageMaker HyperPod, keeping large-scale training and inference clusters
running. This site is where I keep notes on the parts of machine learning I'm
working through — models, inference, and the systems underneath them. I'm
currently in the UBC Master of Data Science program, so some of it overlaps with
coursework, but mostly it's just what I'm reading and building.
